subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should default browser reads become compact and goal-shaped with explicit raw/full escape hatches, and should browser actions return bounded change reports after mutations?
rationale: Current code already has caps and an efficient-mode knob, but changing default model-facing browser semantics and compatibility behavior is a product boundary choice rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Default Compact Browser Contract
options.body: Make omitted/default browser reads compact and goal-shaped, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact post-action change reports with live proof.

options.title: Action Reports First
options.body: Keep snapshot defaults unchanged for now, but add bounded post-action change reports to reduce repeated snapshots during multi-step workflows.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Efficient Mode
options.body: Leave current defaults in place and document browser.snapshotDefaults.mode plus maxChars as the supported mitigation.

recommendation.title: Default Compact Browser Contract
recommendation.body: Make omitted/default browser reads compact and goal-shaped, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact post-action change reports with live proof.
